string.text: Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Anatomical handle
Selecting and installing grip pads that are more suitable for a particular shooter on a weapon allows you to achieve better results when shooting.
Reinforced frame
A frame made of more durable plastic has a beneficial effect on the wear resistance of the weapon.
Lightweight parts
Replacing standard weapon parts with lightweight analogues allows you to reduce the weight of the weapon.
Lightweight magazine
Allows you to slightly reduce the weight of the weapon.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts allows firing at a higher rate.Unfortunately, this causes the weapon to wear out a little faster.
Soft trigger trigger
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to make shooting from weapons more accurate.
Barrel with modified rifling pitch
Allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet.
Recoil compensation system
The compensation system integrated into the design of the weapon significantly reduces felt recoil and contributes to more comfortable shooting.
Improved cutoff
Improving the cartridge ejection system reduces the likelihood of delays during shooting due to the cartridge case sticking after the shot.
Adjusting the locking mechanism
By locking the bore more tightly, the obturation of the bore improves and the muzzle velocity of the bullet increases.
Short shutter stroke
Allows you to increase the rate of fire of a weapon by reducing the time required to feed a new cartridge.
Polymer buffer
Equipping the pistol with a polymer buffer in addition to the standard recoil spring softens recoil.
Chamber adjustment
Allows you to achieve higher shooting accuracy.
